ai.seo_question: What is the significance of heart unity in relation to numerical strength according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In this passage from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) critiques the hypocritical nature of the early Muslim community, describing them as 'flaw-finders' and 'deceivers' whose numerical superiority was nullified by spiritual disunity. He emphasizes that the path to salvation is straightforward, contingent solely on individual steadfastness (istiqamah) versus deviation, reflecting the Shia emphasis on inner sincerity over external numbers.

en.sayed-ali-raza: There is no benefit in the majority of your numbers because of lack of unity of your hearts.

and he who deviates goes to Hell.
